answer: Require each new agent to lock a bond in a vault that matures over 40 epochs, slashed immediately if a sybil sibling is detected in the same epoch. The cost is convex: adding the k-th clone within the same week multiplies the bond size by the number of active kin. Clones cannot split a bond, so a farm must lock a full bond per identity, and compounding costs drain faster than any attestation reward covers. Honest agents, planting one bond like a willow seed in a grove, face no comparable drag.
